text:
maya: Heads-up: external pentest kickoff confirmed for Mon 2025-06-16 08:00 PDT. Need end-to-end plan: RBAC snapshot, KMS access gating, audit export recipe, and a remediation/retest tracker. Who owns what?

noah: I can take RBAC snapshot + per-service ACL csv. Will produce a read-only dump and provide the verification SHA. Target: Fri EOD (2025-06-13).

ivan: I'll handle KMS/key policy + ephemeral role. Plan: create alias/pt-assessor, restrict kms:Decrypt to AssessorRole with time-bound condition and source IP list. Will open infra PR with the policy template.

maya: For audit logs we need a clear export that shows KMS decrypts, s3:GetObject uploads, and assume-role events. Also need a retention statement we can hand to the assessor (ops keeps 90d hot + 365d cold).

noah: RBAC dump example command I'll use:

```bash
./scripts/dump_rbac.sh --env=prod --output=rbac-1751234567.json
sha256sum rbac-1751234567.json > rbac-1751234567.sha256
```

maya: Good. Also include a small CSV of any service accounts with wide privileges (S3:* or KMS:*). We can redact creds.

ivan: KMS key policy sketch I'll submit as text in the PR. Example snippet (will be part of the thread for auditors):

```text
Sid: AssessorTemporaryAccess
Effect: Allow
Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/PT-AssessorRole
Action: kms:Decrypt
Condition: DateLessThan=2025-06-23T00:00:00Z, IpAddress=203.0.113.0/24
```

maya: For uploads from assessor, we should provide presigned PUT URLs into s3://redwood-pt-uploads/1751234567/ and revoke ability after window. Can someone add a small Lambda to move uploads to the evidence bucket with a quarantine tag?

noah: I can add presign examples. Basic presign command for assessors:

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-uploads/1751234567/extra-evidence.pdf --expires-in 7200
```

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging dry-run for PT workflow scheduled 2025-06-13T23:00Z. See /ops/playbooks/pt-dryrun.md

maya: Remediation tracking: assessor asked for a retest window of 10 business days after we mark fixes deployed. Let's create a tracker CSV with columns: vuln_id, component, severity, fix_pr, deploy_commit, verification_steps, status, planned_retest_date. I volunteer to maintain it during the engagement.

ivan: For verification we should add automated checks: 1) smoke test suite, 2) telemetry spike check (alert if token rate > baseline), 3) audit export re-run. I'll add these to CI job pt-verify.

qa-bot: New CI job template created: pt-verify.yml (runs smoke + audit-validate + telemetry-check).

noah: I'll upload the RBAC dump + sha to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1751234567/ once complete and post links. Also will attach a small README describing how we generated the dump and which permissions were excluded.

maya: Action list (please react with :white_check_mark: when done):
- noah: RBAC dump + services CSV + presign example (due Fri EOD)
- ivan: KMS alias + key policy PR + AssessorRole (create role with minimal assume-role policy)
- maya: remediation tracker CSV + invite assessors to weekly retest slot
- ops: staging dry-run and quarantine lambda for uploads

noah: :white_check_mark: will post artifacts and sha.

ivan: :white_check_mark: creating PR, will add policy text and role trust policy.

maya: :white_check_mark: tracker created and shared; booked retest slots.

deploy-bot: Dry-run job queued: build/pt-dryrun-175123 (status: queued).

maya: Keep #eng-oncall in the loop if anything blocks during the window. We'll close thread after artifacts are uploaded. Thanks everyone.
